visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + text + optional 'Read more' button
visualCharacteristics.layout: grid 1 / 2 / 4 columns (<720 / 720-1399 / >=1400px), 4:3 image over a white shadowed tile

contentPattern: One row per card: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = heading, paragraph(s), optional button link. Option jobs: one row per job, single cell = H6 > a (title), p (category), p (date). Option links: one row per group, single cell = H6 > a (title), ul > li > a (links, optional).

options.label: Jobs
options.description: Text-only job list: linked H6 title (18px, weight 600), grey category and date captions; no image, border, shadow or background. 2 columns, 4 from 720px. Use in a section with style 'wide' under a heading. Source: www.cp.com/en/careers .recent-jobs-banner.

options.label: Links
options.description: Text-only sitemap link groups: one row per group, single cell = H6 > a (group title, Arial Black 18px, weight 600) then an optional ul > li > a list of links (18px, black square bullet, 1px white divider under each item); no image, tile, border, shadow or background. 1 column, 4 from 960px. Use in a section with style 'neutral, wide'. Source: www.cp.com/en/sys/sitemap .sitemap .o-grid.
